extraction_scope.limitations: Mechanism is antiviral fusion inhibition/HR1-HR2 six-helix-bundle targeting; no primary-source antibacterial MIC mechanism is claimed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: IPB19 binds the HR1-derived target mimic N52 in a six-helical bundle structure, supporting HR1-HR2 fusion-core targeting.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: IPB19/N52 structural complex and IPB19-based lipopeptide design
mechanism_claims.assay_or_method: CD spectroscopy plus crystal structure of IPB19 complexed with N52

mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural target-mimic evidence supports fusion-inhibition mechanism but does not establish bacterial membrane permeabilization.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: IPB19-derived lipopeptides inhibit SARS-CoV-2 S-mediated cell-cell fusion, pseudovirus entry, and live SARS-CoV-2 infection.
mechanism_claims.assay_or_method: DSP-based cell-cell fusion assay, single-cycle pseudovirus infection assay, and live SARS-CoV-2 infection assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: Functional antiviral inhibition evidence is not an antibacterial MIC endpoint.
